title: vtc-server: ring fork, answered_elsewhere and 30 s timeout
description: Multi-device fork and answered_elsewhere (vtc L1541-1543); 30 s timeout (L1547). Urgency/transport handed to JMAP-gxxm or the consumer.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Tests with injected clock: unanswered ring ends at 30 s (L1547); answer on one device ends others with answered_elsewhere.
notes:
